CustomField.label: Message When Not Applicable
CustomField.description: Optional business-friendly explanation shown when a check is skipped because its applicability condition is not met. Insert record values with {!record.Name} and completed result values with {!rhcResult.foundValue} or {!rhcResult.expectedValue}. Query row tokens are not accepted, because the Check's queries never ran.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Explain why this check does not apply to the current record. Tokens: {!record.FieldApiName}, {!rhcResult.foundValue}. Example: {!record.Name} is a direct customer; this check applies only to channel customers.
